policy.prediction_wall_seconds: Complete external process wall time only; zero is a valid measurement
policy.preparation_wall_seconds: Preparation is separate and shared MSA work is not attributed per method
policy.aggregation: One tool, one complete dataset cohort; equal target weighting, not an unweighted mean of resource groups. Dataset mean is null if any target timing is missing.
policy.resource_strata: Diagnostic breakdown only, not the primary tool-level mean. Dataset means describe observed mixed execution conditions, not hardware-controlled speed benchmarks.
policy.processing_exceptions: Per-target postprocessing differences are explicitly retained in runs and tool summaries.
policy.native_reported: Native partial timings are displayed as reported and excluded from full wall-time aggregates
